content:
root = Stack([alert, contentStack], "column", "m")

alert = Callout("error", "System Outage Detected", "auth-db is currently down. This triggers a widespread cascading failure across the architecture.")

contentStack = Stack([cascadeCard, summaryCard], "column", "l")

cascadeCard = Card([cascadeHeader, cascadeSteps])
cascadeHeader = InlineHeader("Failure Cascade Sequence", "Chronological order of service failures")
cascadeSteps = Steps([step1, step2, step3, step4, step5])
step1 = StepsItem("Tier 1: Auth Layer", "auth-service fails immediately due to direct dependency on auth-db.")
step2 = StepsItem("Tier 2: Cache & Internal Tools", "session-cache and admin-console fail because they cannot reach auth-service.")
step3 = StepsItem("Tier 3: Gateway & Backoffice", "api-gateway fails (depends on auth-service and session-cache). reporting fails (depends on admin-console).")
step4 = StepsItem("Tier 4: Core Capabilities", "checkout and search fail because the api-gateway is unresponsive.")
step5 = StepsItem("Tier 5: Asynchronous Handlers", "notifications fails because the checkout flow is down.")

summaryCard = Card([summaryHeader, summaryCols])
summaryHeader = InlineHeader("Blast Radius Summary", "Impacted vs Unaffected Services")
summaryCols = Stack([failedCol, healthyCol], "row", "l", "start", "start", true)

failedCol = Stack([failedTitle, failedTags], "column", "s")
failedTitle = TextContent("Failed Services (9)", "small-heavy")
failedTags = TagBlock(["auth-db", "auth-service", "session-cache", "admin-console", "api-gateway", "reporting", "checkout", "search", "notifications"])

healthyCol = Stack([healthyTitle, healthyTags], "column", "s")
healthyTitle = TextContent("Unaffected Services (3)", "small-heavy")
healthyTags = TagBlock(["payments", "fraud-check", "search-index"])
